CONSTRUCTION: points allowed come from the joint simulation, so a defence is short the opposing offence by construction. Sacks and takeaways are drawn from the empirical pairs measured within the relevant points-allowed band, which keeps their dependence on the game intact.

scoring_tail.definition: a touchdown whose scoring club was NOT the club on offence, which is what DK credits to a defence, plus safeties
scoring_tail.known_omission: a muffed kick recovered in the end zone by the KICKING team is not counted; it is rare and it is named rather than absorbed
scoring_tail.WAS_PREVIOUSLY: excluded as unrecoverable, because TEAM_GAME records only offensive touchdowns. That was true of TEAM_GAME and false of the repository: play-by-play carries td_team and safety directly.

_lineage.BUILT_AT_IS_NOT_A_FRESHNESS_TEST: wall-clock is recorded for humans. Staleness is decided by comparing content hashes, because an artifact rebuilt from unchanged inputs is not newer information and an artifact built just before its builder was edited is not current.
